feeds.title: FineWoodworking
feeds.description: Expert advice on woodworking and furniture making, with thousands of how-to videos, step-by-step articles, project plans, photo galleries, tool reviews, and blogs. Fine Woodworking provides all woodworkers with unique inspiration and information to improve their skills, accuracy, and efficiency. It is the most trusted resource for unbiased, credible information among passionate woodworkers.

feeds.title: Popular Woodworking Blog
feeds.description: A woodworking magazine that provides resources, projects, how-to articles, and artist features. Contributors include Roy Underhill, Christopher Schwarz, Mary May, Bob Flexner, Toshio Odate, and Gary Rogowski.

feeds.title: Paul Sellers Blog
feeds.description: Paul Sellers' woodworking blog with opinions on hand tool woodworking. You'll find woodworking tutorials, tips, and techniques.

feeds.title: Jays Custom Creations
feeds.description: Blog by Jay Bates covering all about Carpentry including Indoor & Outdoor Projects, Woodworking Projects, how-tos, and Custom DIYs.

feeds.title: Pinto Carpentry Blog
feeds.description: With over 20 years of experience, we provide quality wooden stairs & indoor railing installation. We use the best quality materials for our railings and our attention to detail is impeccable. We work meticulously to ensure our clients are satisfied for years to come. We specialize in wooden indoor stairs & indoor railing installation.

feeds.title: The Bespoke Carpentry Blog
feeds.description: Check out our blog at The Bespoke Carpentry Co. to keep up to date with all the latest news, tips, and guides when it comes to reclaimed wood furniture. The Bespoke Carpentry Co. offers Rustic, Reclaimed, and unique designs created from scratch at competitive prices.

feeds.title: Cobb Brothers Company Blog
feeds.description: The Cobb Brothers Blog shares some of the basic things people should know about Carpentry and Painting. Learn helpful tips and advice about what makes furniture great. The Cobb Brothers Company is a dependable, professional, Painting Contractor based in Massachusetts.

feeds.title: House of Fine Carpentry
feeds.description: House of Fine Carpentry Blog gives you tips, tricks and advice about carpentry, our services, and other interesting facts in our industry. At House of Fine Carpentry, our goal is to provide you with high-quality custom cabinetry, kitchens, trim, molding, and more.

feeds.title: EASRCC Carpenters
feeds.description: Get the latest news and announcements from the Eastern Atlantic States Regional Council of Carpenters. The council forms part of a larger Nation-wide organization, the United Brotherhood of Carpenters and Joiners of America which work to advance and better the right and lives of American Workers.

feeds.title: The Carpenter's Daughter
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Vikkie and I'm a carpenter's daughter, taking the advice of my father to tackle almost every thinkable DIY project in our very first home. Girls can do DIY too! I'm renovating our first home and this blog is about how I've done it and what I've learned.

feeds.title: Ana White Blog
feeds.description: Learn simple DIY furniture designs, tool recommendations, and other amazing Carpentry plans for your home in this blog by Ana White. Ana White has been building DIY projects for almost twenty years. Her goal is to help people improve their homes with basic tools on limited budgets.

feeds.title: Universal Framing Carpentry Blog
feeds.description: Read our recent blog posts diving into the best Residential Framing practices and Repair techniques. Learn more about what we do and our services. Universal Framing Carpentry provides all in framing services, such as Framing, Custom House Framing, New Addition Framing, and more.

feeds.title: Preservation Timber Framing
feeds.description: Check out the latest projects and work from Arron Sturgis as he shares his daily stores and work updates. Arron owns and operates Preservation Timber Framing, a traditional timber framing company specializing in the structural repair of historic timber-framed buildings.

feeds.title: Timber Traditions Blog
feeds.description: A blog of DIY carpentry tutorials for creative enthusiasts. Explore easy-to-follow step-by-step videos perfect for beginners. Timber Traditions Carpentry & Joinery is a family-owned and operated business servicing the Perth region of Western Australia.

feeds.title: Kernow Coast Carpentry Blog
feeds.description: Kernow Coast Carpentry is a Cornwall-based CNC machining, Laser cutting, and Bespoke carpentry company catering to your needs. Take a look at our blog for more information on our company. We provide bespoke, one-of-a-kind, unique solutions for you or your business.

feeds.title: Westbrook Restorations Carpentry & Millwork Blog
feeds.description: Daniel J. Westbrook specializes in custom carpentry and millwork for historic, vintage, and mid-century modern homes. He is a hands-on master carpenter providing a variety of custom carpentry and woodshop services including; historic windows and sash, stairs and balustrades, milling moldings, and more.

feeds.title: Level Headed Carpentry Blog
feeds.description: Read regular updates from our blogs for unique and innovative content related to carpentry. Find beautiful decore tips and insights and guides on home maintenance. Level Headed Carpentry is a Sydney-Based Company carrying out works across Sydney and Surrounding areas. We provide 100% client satisfaction on every project undertaken, catering to all aspects of carpentry.

feeds.title: Mertens Carpentry Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about what's new and important at Mertens Carpentry. We share critical news and information from the world of Carpentry in this blog. Mertens Carpentry, Inc provides framing of single-family, multi-family, and light commercial buildings in St. Michael, MN, and surrounding areas.

feeds.title: Top Deck Carpentry Blog
feeds.description: The team at Top Deck Carpentry with more than 20 years of experience is here to help. Brad Henley is your local timber expert and his team takes pride in the top-quality finishes of their workmanship. The team specializes in all aspects of carpentry, decking, and home renovations.

feeds.title: The Samurai Carpenter Blog
feeds.description: The Samurai Carpenter shares videos documenting DIY Woodwork projects, Personal blogs, Equipment tools, and reviews, and a few tricks & hacks. Samurai Carpenter provides aid to inspire and equip you to build your dream woodworking projects whether big or small.

feeds.title: Jen Woodhouse Blog
feeds.description: Jen Woodhouse authors The House of Wood as her creative outlet for all things DIY and design, where she documents her adventures in woodworking, interior design, military life, marriage, and motherhood. She offers in-depth tutorials that inspire and encourage readers to build their way to a more beautiful home.

feeds.title: Carpentrix
feeds.description: Nina MacLaughlin left her job at an alt-weekly to become a carpenter in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

feeds.title: The Honest Carpenter Blog
feeds.description: A Carpentry blog to help homeowners and DIYers with quality advice on a variety of topics. Blog posts cover everything Carpentry from basic construction and real estate knowledge to DIY projects and modern remodelling techniques.

feeds.title: Carpenter Headquarters Blog
feeds.description: In this website, we arranged a directory of carpentry schools in each state, we have answers to your most frequently asked questions, we have a blog section to teach you everything you need to know especially about getting a job as a carpenter.
